as_told.title: Trump told about hybrids in UFO briefing

plain: The claim is that Donald Trump has been briefed on secret long-running government programmes about UAP, the official term for UFOs. The researcher Matthew Pines says he is "pretty confident" Trump knows at least "broad contours that this is real", while saying how much he knows is speculation. Eric Burlison, a US congressman, goes further, relaying second hand that in the briefing Trump was told there are hybrids, part human and part alien beings, and that Trump replied, "You mean like Adam Schiff", naming a political rival. If true, a US president would have been told directly that the phenomenon is real.
